decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute because the extra charge has already been refunded. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, 13 days after TXN-007974 posted on 2026-10-14. That is within the 120-day limit. The ledger shows two purchases at QUAYSIDE CLOTHING for 7502 EUR minor units each, both made on 2026-10-13 and posted on 2026-10-14. They are TXN-007973 and TXN-007974, and both carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008175 (approved, e-commerce, 3-D Secure authenticated). So the charge was a real duplicate: one authorisation posted twice. However, the merchant refunded the disputed posting through TXN-007975 (refund of 7502, posted 2026-10-18, related to TXN-007974). The cardholder has therefore paid for only one purchase, and nothing remains in dispute under the duplicate-already-refunded rule.
